games.name: Undertale: The Obby [NEW ENDING]
games.desc:
Added some details to every main area and reworked Chara fight ending. Also added Spamton Pet, Undying pet and Sans pet. The next update will probably be the final one.

Leaving a like is the best way to support this game. Good luck and thank you for playing!

Faq:
Q: How do I get Neutral Ending?
A: Just play through normally.

Q: How do I get True Ending?
A: You need to hang out with Papyrus, Undyne and Alphys. They are all in their houses, but you can only hang out with them after sparing them in battle. And yes, you will have to RESET at the end of Neutral Ending.

Q: How do I get No Mercy Ending?
A: Beat True Ending and FIGHT 1 monster per main area. They can only be fought after beating True Ending.

Q: How do I FIGHT Chara?
A: Beat No Mercy Ending and look for her in the Ruins.

games.name: [UPDATE 2.5] Era of Althea
games.desc:
Era of Althea welcomes those who favor adventure and exploration. Dive into a world of magic where all who enter have the chance to become a great fighter. While adventures may prove to be difficult, persevering and overcoming them will be fulfilling.

Those who dwell in this realm progress by exploring the land and its secrets. Level up to achieve great feats, obtain rare items to assist you in battle, or band together to form guilds. There are many possibilities as to how you may choose to endure the trials found within the world of Althea.

This game is inspired by Black Clover & Sword Art Online, though it is created by our original concepts.

M - Open Menu
Q - Dash
R - Toggle Fist Combat
F - Toggle Weapon
LMB - Attack (Fist or Weapons must be equipped)
RMB - Block (Fist or Weapons must be equipped)
Shift - Run (Can be changed in Settings)
Alt - Shiftlock
~ - View Grimoire Pages
